reviews.comment: The easiest class I have taken so far. He goes by the syllabus and grades really easily. Tests are online for a full day and open note (all the notes you will need are shared by him). He is very sweet and makes it very easy for students.

If you're looking for an easy A blowoff class, Urban Issues with SeWoong is the way to go. Attendance is not necessary nor mandatory and exams are online and open note and he posts the PowerPoints where the tests come straight from. I am an Engineering major and it was so nice to be able to put not even an ounce of effort into this class.
I totally recommend talking him for 361! His exams are very straightforward and open note! A few papers but not too hard, 100% take him!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Participation matters--Graded by few things
